column1: # Brother inkjet capability table for brother-pwg-macos.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are ignored. The "*" row must come last;
# it is the generic fallback for models nobody has qualified yet.
# status           "verified" only if someone printed tools/make-testpage.py on
#                  that hardware and reported the result. Everything else is
# qualities        subset of Draft,Normal,Best,Photo. Resolution is implied:
#                  Draft=300, Normal=600, Best=600, Photo=1200 dpi. A model that
#                  cannot reach 1200 dpi simply omits Photo.
# borderless       page-size keywords that get a .Fullbleed variant, or "none".
#                  Never populate this for an unverified model: on a printer
#                  that does not support borderless, ink lands on the platen and
#                  marks the back of the following pages.
# trays            integer count; only tray 1 is currently driven.
# Known page-size keywords: A4 Letter Legal A5 A6 Executive 4x6 5x7 5x8 3.5x5
